title: Repeat-Removal Processing Charge — Northgate Business Memberships
content:
**Charge.** On Northgate Memberships business memberships, removals of add-on cards by the primary member in the three months before the refund carry a repeat-removal processing charge of 10.00 dollars when there are three or more of them, 4.00 dollars when there are two, and nothing when there is one. The charge is taken off the refund of the removed add-on card's fee, which never goes below zero.

**Counting.** The removals are the card deactivations on the membership whose reason is removal by the primary member, dated fewer than three whole months before the refund. The removal the refund is for is one of them.

| Removals by the primary member in the three months before the refund | Repeat-removal processing charge |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 10.00 |
| 2 | 4.00 |
| 1 | nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical; refund worked on 20 June 2027)

| Removals dated | Removals counted | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| 20 June 2027 only | 1 | nothing |
| 21 March 2027 and 20 June 2027 | 2 | 4.00 |
| 20 March 2027 and 20 June 2027 | 1 (20 March is three whole months before) | nothing |
| 2 May, 1 June and 20 June 2027 | 3 | 10.00 |
